stop_rule: Haiku: cells start in the registered order; a cell starts only if the round's measured Haiku spend plus the expected cost of the cells in flight plus this cell's upper bound stays within 7 USD; the first cell that does not fit ends the block. Sonnet: only if the Anthropic programme total (ledger total before the round plus every round-7 run) is below 95 USD after the Haiku block, and only if that total plus the cell's upper bound stays within 98 USD.
